name: Verify attempt to update closed ticket provides explanation and new ticket option
objective: Validate that when a user tries to update a closed ticket, the assistant explains it is closed and offers to create a new ticket.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. User has a closed ticket INC-99999.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Attempt to add information to a closed ticket
steps.expectedResult: The assistant retrieves the ticket status

steps.description: Verify the assistant explains the ticket is closed
steps.expectedResult: The assistant clearly states that INC-99999 is closed and cannot be updated

steps.description: Verify the option to create a new ticket is offered
steps.expectedResult: The assistant offers to create a new ticket instead
